description: Human pilot mode (docs/human_pilot_mode.md): a person flies the vehicle from the two pictures a policy is given (front and down, 256 x 256) and the sentence, with the policy's three axes, and the flight is recorded in the format of the teacher's recordings. Nothing here changes a model, a gate or an earlier result.
layouts_from: the recording layouts of every generic landing stage (configs/generic_landing_stage1d.json, layouts.train). The layouts checks are flown in (t, u, p, q, r, s) and the canonical ones (e, g, h, i, j) are refused.
distance_from: the validated range of the canonical evaluation (44 m); 12 m keeps the object out of reach of the first decision
acceleration_from: eases a key press in: 0 to the fastest forward speed (2 m/s) in 1.3 s, a full turn rate (24 deg/s) in 0.3 s. The vehicle's own response (about 2.4 s to follow a change of velocity) is the simulator's and is not changed: the recorded flights must move as a policy's flights move.
terminal_from: configs/visual_search.json stop_ticks: a policy ends a flight by giving the stop four decisions in a row; the teacher's recordings end the same way
